how_to: Generate each entry in ChatGPT, save with the given filename into assets/NewForReview/, then tell Claude. Every image: original design, no text, no existing-franchise references.
shared_style: Square game inventory icon. A single sci-fi object, three-quarter view, centred, on a very dark navy background (#0b1016) inside a thin light-grey rounded square frame with a small margin. Realistic brushed and scuffed metal with small glowing accents, dramatic rim light, soft glow. No text, no letters, no labels, no numbers anywhere in the image (the game adds names itself, so art stays language-neutral). No watermark, no border outside the frame. Painterly-realistic like a premium space-game item shop.

images.prompt: One image, 1536x1024, a 4-column by 2-row grid of 8 game UI icons in matching style: realistic high-detail 3D-rendered objects, each centered in its own rounded-square cell with a very dark navy-black background (#0a0e14) and a thin subtle silver-grey border, three-quarter view from slightly above, dramatic studio lighting, crisp silhouettes that read at small size. Left to right, top row then bottom row: 1) a holographic comms handset projecting a faint blue glow (talk to the station broker); 2) a wall-mounted job board slate with glowing pinned cards, blank of any writing; 3) a stack of sealed cargo crates with a price-tag clip (store); 4) crossed heavy wrench and welding torch with sparks (maintenance); 5) a ship engine module with an upward-glowing upgrade arrow shape made of light (upgrades); 6) a cocktail glass with a faint neon reflection on a bar top (lounge); 7) an industrial refinery canister with pipes and a blue glow (fuel refinery); 8) a locked vault storage locker (storage). Original design for an original sci-fi game, not based on any existing game or franchise. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, symbols or watermarks anywhere.

images.used_for: Muzzle flash, spark burst, shockwave ring, shield ripple (P2)
images.prompt: One image, 1024x1024, a 2 by 2 grid of four separate additive-blend visual effect textures on a pure black background, each centered in its quarter with space around it: top-left a bright weapon muzzle flash, a star-shaped burst of white-hot light fading to orange at the tips; top-right a burst of bright metallic sparks flying outward from a point; bottom-left a thin glowing circular shockwave ring, bright pale blue at the edge fading inward, mostly empty center; bottom-right a translucent hexagonal energy shield ripple pattern in cyan spreading from an impact point. Soft glows, no hard black outlines. Original design for an original sci-fi game, not based on any existing game or franchise. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, symbols or watermarks anywhere.

images.used_for: Per-system sky panoramas by star type (P5)
images.prompt: A seamless 2:1 equirectangular space panorama for a game skybox: deep space full of fine stars of varied brightness, with {VARIANT}. Photographic, subtle, not cartoony; the stars must stay sharp and small; the left and right edges must tile seamlessly; no planets, no ships, no stations. Run four times with {VARIANT} = (1) a large soft warm nebula in amber and rose with dark dust lanes; (2) a cool blue and teal nebula veil across one third of the sky; (3) a thick brown-grey dust cloud band with a few bright young stars glowing through it; (4) almost empty dark space with a faint distant galaxy smudge and sparse stars. Original design for an original sci-fi game, not based on any existing game or franchise. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, symbols or watermarks anywhere.
